content.text: {"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot \"accessory\" is for an item no other slot fits.", "\"is_outfit\" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following \"answer_schema\", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": ["\"description\" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Crisp white silk blouse with a relaxed fit and a slightly dropped shoulder for effortless comfort; navy blue wide-leg trousers in a fluid crepe that drape gently to accentuate the waistline without restriction. Nude satin pointed-toe pumps with a moderate heel provide an elevated yet grounded silhouette suitable for standing or dancing during the evening. Delicate pearl drop earrings add a touch of refined sparkle to complement the charitable event atmosphere while keeping the focus on natural beauty. This outfit respects the summer season despite the autumn seasonal tag by using breathable fabrics and a bright palette that feels celebratory rather than heavy, avoiding any forced stylistic overhauls to honor her recovery journey. The monochromatic neutral base creates a polished look appropriate for an upscale restaurant, allowing her to feel supported and confident without needing conscious styling manipulation."}
